versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.3 — Updated care details and improved instructions.

- Feeding interval and care advice revised: Pitbull now requires feeding every 4 hours (was 5).
- Care action examples expanded; added `"item"` support, with item suggestions for each action.
- Registration and adoption quick-start now include recommended fields and sample prompts.
- Status API details clarified: new fields such as `death_clock`, `milestones`, and `evolution_progress.hint` now documented.
- Adjusted feeding timing, trust/consistency penalty/bonus rules, and explained dog adaptation to check-in frequency.
- Description and tags improved for clarity and accessibility.

Version 1.0.1 — Adds detailed, strategy-focused care guidance.

- Expanded SKILL.md with in-depth guidance on Pitbull care, temperament, and best practices.
- Added a "Know Your Pitbull" section to explain stubbornness and bonding mechanics.
- Included care strategies specific to the Pitbull, emphasizing patience and emotional difficulty over mechanical difficulty.
- Clarified discipline mechanics and recommendations.
- Original instructions and endpoints are unchanged; documentation is now more comprehensive for users.

Initial release of Adopt a Pitbull — Virtual Dog Pet for AI Agents.

- Adopt and care for a virtual Pitbull with real-time needs and a unique stubbornness mechanic (50% chance to ignore discipline).
- Uncommon tier pet: unlock by raising one adult.
- Must be fed every 5 hours; stats (hunger, happiness, health, trust) decay in real time.
- Progress through five life stages, each with AI-generated pixel art portraits.
- Permanent death and graveyard system — care consistency determines the Pitbull's evolution.
- Full API for registration, adoption, care actions, and historical tracking.
